program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # diff pair L (gain + flicker area)
    "itail": (6e-6, 3e-6, 12e-6),    # first-stage tail current
    "gmid3": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror / M6 gm/Id (matched for offset)
    "L3":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # PMOS mirror / M6 L
    "i6":    (24e-6, 12e-6, 40e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmidb": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # NMOS bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lb":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # NMOS bias mirror L
    "cc":    (4e-12, 1.5e-12, 8e-12),# Miller cap
    "rzk":   (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = rzk / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it, i6, cc = p["itail"], p["i6"], p["cc"]

    # NMOS bias: diode on ibias, tail and second-stage sink mirrored (same gm/Id, L)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], it, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidb"], p["Lb"], i6, vds=0.9)

    # diff pair (source ~0.25-0.3 V)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=0.45, vsb=0.25)

    # PMOS mirror load and second-stage driver (same gm/Id, L -> zero systematic offset)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], it / 2, vds=1.1)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], it / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i6, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tl", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # first stage: vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tl", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vo1", "vinp", "tl", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vo1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "vo1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    # compensation
    n.R("RZ", "vo1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    a0 = a1 * a2
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cc)
    cout = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (cc * cout + c1 * (cc + cout)))
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    dz = rz - 1.0 / m6.gm
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * cc * dz) if dz > 0 else 1e15
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / pm_mirror)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / z))
    slew = min(it / cc, i6 / (cl + cc))
    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    settle = 0.2 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i6)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sth = 2 * (8 * kT / 3 / m1.gm) * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm)
    noise = math.sqrt(sth) * 20          # flicker-dominated rough estimate
    cmrr = a1 * 2 * m3.gm / max(m5.gds, 1e-12)
    psrr = 2 * a0

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": gbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "power": power,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(psrr),
        "noise_1k": noise,
        "swing": 0.9,
    }
